notes.title: Lords of Exile - Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
📢 Hello Fellow Retro-Gamers! 📢 

Thank you all for your patience and understanding. We are ready to announce the good news that everyone must be waiting for!

Lords of Exile, the nostalgia-inducing side-scrolling action platformer, is set to finally release on *drumroll please*14th February 2024!

[previewyoutube=jCLStFXS80E;full][/previewyoutube]
Stay tuned and get ready to embark on a journey filled with samurais, revenge, and pixelated excitement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37850933/16cd49c456cf1b8ce2a88d7c82ed47c47d5a8410.jpg
